study type: Case-control study nested in a birth cohort
outcome: Fetal overgrowth (defined as larger-for-gestational-age birth weight >90th percentile)
cohort: The study included 125 pairs of larger-for-gestational-age (LGA) and optimal-for-gestational-age (OGA) infants from the Shanghai Birth Cohort, matched by sex and gestational age.
finding: Cord blood RBP-4 concentrations were elevated in LGA infants and positively correlated with birth weight z score, with IGF-I (but not IGF-II) mediating a significant portion of this association.
gest_age: Infants were classified as larger-for-gestational-age or optimal-for-gestational-age, and groups were matched by gestational age.
